notes.title: 1.2.3 – Bye Bugs, Hello Precision
notes.content:
[p]🙌 Update’s here![/p][p]A small but important patch:[/p][p]– ✅ [b]Scoring bug fixed[/b] — now the first hoop counts properly.
– ✅ [b]No more weird ball physics[/b] — the ball flies smooth and accurate now.
– ✅ [b]Random glitches & screen freezes[/b] — gone.
– ✅ [b]Overall stability improved[/b] — no more surprises.[/p][p]Huge thanks to everyone who reported bugs — you're helping shape a better SkyDunker 💙[/p]

notes.title: 4 New Game Modes – Test Your Aim in the Sky!
notes.content:
[p]🆕 [b]SkyDunker just got a major upgrade![/b][/p][p]Four fresh game modes are now live — each designed to challenge your skills and reflexes:[/p][p]🔸 [b]Hidden Hoop[/b] – Appears for 1 second. Remember its location and shoot blind!
🔸 [b]Falling Hoops[/b] – Hoops drop fast. Act quickly before they disappear!
🔸 [b]Time Attack[/b] – Score as much as you can in 60 seconds. +2 sec for hits, -3 sec for misses.
🔸 [b]Vanishing Hoop[/b] – Appears briefly and fades away. Time your shot right![/p][p]🏆 [b]Coming Soon:[/b]
A full leaderboard system for each mode. Compete, climb ranks, and become a sky legend![/p][p]💬 Enjoying the update? Leave a review and spread the word — it helps us a lot.[/p][p]See you in the clouds,
[b]SkyDunker Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Boost Your Aim – Wind & Score Multipliers Incoming!
notes.content:
🏀 **Update Coming Soon!**

Get ready for new gameplay twists: the next SkyDunker update will challenge your aiming skills and reward your precision!

### 💨 What’s new:
- **Wind Obstacles** — external forces will now interfere with your ball trajectory. Get ready to adjust your shots!
- **Score Multipliers**:
  - 🎯 Perfect shot — **2x score**
  - 🏀 Bounce off the hoop — **3x score**

These features add skill-based rewards and more variety to each match.

---
Stay tuned for the update, and let us know your feedback!
